title: Sakina Bhool gayi zayeqa bhi paani ka
body:
Haye sakina, haye pyaas..(2)
gila bhi karti nahi apni tashnakami ka
<<MINI>>
sakina bhool gayi zaeqa bhi pani ka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Wo pehli shaam judayi ki aur wo tanhayi
wo ghup andhera wo maqtal wo yaad baba ki..(2)
mayaan e dard o alam hai safar yateema ka
<<MINI>>
sakina bhool gayi zaeqa bhi pani ka
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Hai dastane sitam wo jala hua kurta
nisha'n tamacho ke rukhsaar par daleel e jafa..(2)
gawahi zulm ki deta hai zakhm seyli ka
<<MINI>>
sakina bhool gayi zaeqa bhi pani ka
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Talaash seena e sarwar hai aur sakina hai
ajeeb hooka sa manzar hai aur sakina hai..(2)
na puch haal aye ghazi teri bhatiji ka
<<MINI>>
sakina bhool gayi zaeqa bhi pani ka
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Phuphi ko takti hai hasrat se ye sukhan keh kar
figaar kaano se behta hai khoon reh reh kar..(2)
gulu ko karta hai zakhmi hisaar rassi ka
<<MINI>>
sakina bhool gayi zaeqa bhi pani ka
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Wo wehshatein wo udasi wo khauf aur wo ghazab
jo qaid e shaam mein guzri wo sakhtiya'n hai ajab..(2)
ye dil ke waaste samaa'n hai ghum gusari ka
<<MINI>>
sakina bhool gayi zaeqa bhi pani ka
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Padar ke baad kabhi chayn ki na neend aayi
ajab sitam hai padar par na khul ke ro payi..(2)
wo ghum bhula na saki baap ki judayi ka
<<MINI>>
sakina bhool gayi zaeqa bhi pani ka
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Sitam ki saari hado se guzar gayi akhir
padar ki yaad mein asif wo marr gayi akhir
chalo ye waqt hai zainab se pursa daari ka
<<MINI>>
sakina bhool gayi zaeqa bhi pani ka
